title.narrative: Sector plan to phase-out HCFC-141b in the foam sector

description.narrative: HCFC-141b used in the manufacture of PU foams in the Philippines will be phased by the end of 2012. The present HCFC-141b technology utilized for the production of flexible foams will be converted to water technology, while that for rigid foams will be concerted to CP or water blown technology, depending of enterprises# size and present level of technology. The government of the Philippines will put in place policies to ban the use of HCFC-141b in the foam sector by the end of 2014. The overall HPMP (WB), the domestic air-conditioning sector (WB) and the commercial refrigeration sector (UNDP) are yet to be developed. The overall HPMP submission is foreseen for the July 2011 ExCom meeting. To date, this project is the only means for the Government of Philippines to achieve the compliance with the MP obligation of 2013 and 2015.
